site.name: Alice A Tunnel
site.componentDetail: Named historic tunnel locality in the Breckenridge mining area; the point is a site-level identification anchor, not a field-surveyed current portal.
overview: Alice A Tunnel is a named historic lode-mining locality in the Breckenridge area of Summit County. The U.S. Geological Survey included the tunnel in its database of principal lode mines and mineralized areas in southern Summit County.
The map point identifies the historic locality at site level. It does not establish the condition or precise position of a surviving portal.
moreHistory: This record is an identification marker rather than a visitor-access claim. Historic mine openings may be unstable, concealed, or on restricted property; do not enter mine workings and respect all closures and property boundaries.
